change: Move landExpansion.unitIds into the per-unit claims registry, preserving both durable mission membership and the existing short ordinary order leases.

membership.expansionMineId: The sole durable membership record, on unitClaims[id]. Follows the current mission; defense reassignment, funding failure, death/owner loss and a new mine release it.
membership.expansionMission: Membership-only claim after the ordinary order lease expires or is cleared. Hidden from ordinaryUnitClaim/activeUnitClaim so it does not introduce a new shop/loot/hire exclusion.
membership.ordinaryLease: The old expansion claim still lasts 30 ticks and is pruned at a foundation. Accepted orders clear/replace the ordinary lease on the same schedule. Local retreat and temporary defense keep their prior command behavior.
membership.paused: Membership remains while paused, but expansionOwnsDefender returns false. Resume reclaims the same retained live members plus available recruits.
membership.snapshotImport: bootstrapPolicyContext imports an old replay/debug unitIds list once and deletes the field before selecting forces. prepareExpansionMission also supports direct callers.

commandEquivalence.comparison: Raw JSON bytes, without sorting, filtering, rounding or normalizing any commands. Both planned entries (including empty think frames) and issued orders are compared. Final snapshot bytes are also identical.

sharedFunctions: recordAiMemoryForCommands / recordAttackWaveMemory / recordUnitTaskClaim: retain mission membership when ordinary leases change
pruneAiPolicyMemory: preserve live membership while expiring ordinary leases; remove dead/wrong-owner members
activeUnitClaim / ordinaryUnitClaim: membership-only entries are not ordinary tactical claims
clearUnitClaim / setUnitClaim / forgetExpansionMember: central registry updates
core neutral objective release: clear ordinary lease through the same registry helper
mining-leash expansionOwnsDefender / temporary guard release: replace the old roster with registry membership
existingTests: Only membership access/setup changed in expansion-mission, mining-leash and defense-claims tests; all physical timing, defense ownership, escort and funding assertions retained.
behaviorFollowUp: Garrison behavior is deliberately unchanged. The next expansion still takes all six archers/footmen after the natural completes; a separate PR will retain a garrison.

validation.focused: expansion mission 6 + defense claims 14 + mining leash 7; lifecycle 10 passed
validation.finalTestCase: Final test-only changes supply the required mine amount and rename the saved-snapshot test to satisfy the source naming boundary; production source is unchanged from aa913a08.

fullSrcFailures.naming: A prohibited word in the new test title was fixed. package-boundaries and the new tests pass on both juma and mac1; the new docs naming was checked too.
fullSrcFailures.presets: SDK parallel preset exceeded 5000ms during the full run. Unchanged test passes isolated on juma (1620ms) and the same mac1 (1028ms). No timeout was changed.

validation.result: All 673 source test files covered: 671 passed in the full run, the two failed files pass after the title fix and isolated rechecks. 7539 tests pass, one is skipped. Final tsc --noEmit exits 0.
